market.summary: The weak open did not last: the Nifty rose for a fifth day to a two-month closing high, and smaller stocks did better than the index, which helps your holdings more than the headline does. Democrats won both houses of the US Congress and US stocks rose after the result. IT was the only sector down, on worry about AI spending and trade policy, and none of your trades is in IT. The screener's NIFTY 500 reading still ends on 3 Nov because of an NSE outage in the evening run, so its size-down message should be re-read once the 4 Nov close is in.

points.text: Sectors: Media +5.15%, Realty +2.85%, Metal +2.80%, Energy +2.17%, FMCG +1.50%, Auto +1.16%; IT -1.50%.

Democrats took the House and Senate. A page read tonight showed Dow +2.04%, S&P 500 +1.55%, Nasdaq +2.12% on 4 Nov; its capture time is not stated, so these may not be closes. Trump said he would veto their bills. Tariffs were not discussed in the article body.
FIIs bought Rs 6,836.81 Cr on 3 Nov, the third day of net buying; the 4 Nov figure was not available in what was read. Rupee closed at 94.64 per dollar; Brent about $102.5.

market.watch: The 4 Nov FII figure, the NIFTY 500 against its 200 DMA (22,764 on the last reading), and Titan's results on 5 Nov.

GROWW.summary: No company news: no filing or deal. The stock held yesterday's jump and closed at a new high since entry, so the trade is +0.53R. The Finance Minister's remark behind that jump is still only a willingness to hear feedback; no tax change has been announced. BSE Ltd fell 1.75% today, so the capital-markets group was not one-way.

points.text: Close Rs 207.23 on 0.92x volume; entry Rs 200.80, stop Rs 188.75, +1R Rs 212.85.
Sitharaman said on 3 Nov the government will consider feedback on equity taxes; no formal decision on LTCG. The Nifty Capital Markets index rose over 3% that day.
BSE Ltd closed Rs 3,601.50, -1.75%, among the day's Nifty losers listed.

GROWW.watch: A close at or above Rs 212.85 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; the stop stays Rs 188.75 until then.

SEJALLTD.summary: No filing, deal or news found. It closed below the stop for another day, so the closing-basis exit signal stays open at -1.13R. Volume was only 0.23x normal, and the stock barely moved on a day smaller stocks rose 2%, which is not a repair.

points.text: Close Rs 831.95; average cost Rs 884.13, stop Rs 838.03. Over 5 sessions (to 3 Nov) it was -5.2% while its index was +2.9%.
Last filing is the 27 Oct call transcript; no bulk or block deal in 10 days. The monthly RSI bearish divergence flag remains.

SEJALLTD.watch: The exit signal stays open in My trades; only a close above Rs 838.03 clears it.

THELEELA.summary: Chalet Hotels' results are the sector read and they support room-rate strength: revenue per room rose 7.2% on higher rates, though occupancy slipped. Chalet's headline profit jump is mostly a one-time tax credit and its revenue fall is property sales, so neither says much about hotels. The trade is +1.89R with the stop above cost and nothing company-specific changed. The 2 Nov investor-meet filing could not be opened from here, so its content is not verified.

points.text: Chalet Q2 FY27: RevPAR Rs 8,702 (+7.2%), room rate Rs 13,546 (+11.3%), occupancy 64.2% (-2.44 points). Resort RevPAR +33.8%, business hotels +5.4%. The article names fuel prices, airfares and fewer flights as headwinds.
Chalet profit Rs 216 Cr included a one-time deferred tax credit (about Rs 112-118 Cr, the two reports differ); real-estate revenue fell from Rs 282 Cr to under Rs 1 Cr.
Close Rs 663.45, peak close Rs 671.05; swing stop Rs 610.96 (21 EMA), position stop Rs 604.51. Weekly RSI bearish divergence flag remains: a warning, not an exit.

THELEELA.watch: +2R is Rs 666.81; a close under Rs 610.96 is the swing stop.

INDHOTEL.summary: The stock closed at its high of the day and a new peak since entry, +1.39R, with the stop at cost, so the trade no longer risks capital on a closing basis. Chalet's numbers support the rate story for hotels. No new filing; the analyst meet named for 5 Nov is tomorrow, and that filing could not be opened from here, so its content is not verified.

points.text: Close Rs 849.00 on 0.93x volume, last close in range 100%; swing and position stop Rs 785.83 (cost); +2R Rs 876.55.
Chalet Q2 FY27 RevPAR +7.2% on room rates +11.3%, with occupancy down 2.44 points to 64.2%.

INDHOTEL.watch: Anything filed after the 5 Nov analyst meet; +2R at Rs 876.55.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: Saregama's strong results are good news for music rights: its music revenue rose 35% and its shares jumped about 13%, leading a 5% rise in the media index. Tips did not join in and closed flat. So the sector read supports the trade, but today's buying went elsewhere. No Tips filing or deal; the trade is +0.89R with the stop at cost.

points.text: Saregama Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 314.3 Cr (+37%), profit Rs 64.2 Cr (+47%), music revenue Rs 251.3 Cr (+35%) at about 61% EBITDA margin.
Nifty Media +5.15%; Saregama +13.3%, Zee +10%. Tips is not mentioned in the report.
Tips close Rs 786.55 vs Rs 787.25, volume 0.68x; peak close Rs 793.90; swing stop Rs 737.59, position stop Rs 727.89 (cost).

TIPSMUSIC.watch: A close above Rs 793.90 resumes the move; a close under Rs 737.59 is the swing stop.

BHAGERIA.summary: The stock fell about 3% on a day smaller stocks rose 2% and closed under the stop, so the plan's exit signal is now open at -1.76R, one session after your entry. No filing, deal or news explains it, and chemical peers abroad were weak. The stayed SEBI order is unchanged, with the tribunal date on 5 Jan 2027.

points.text: Close Rs 354.35 vs Rs 365.45 on 3 Nov, volume 0.91x; entry Rs 367.46, stop Rs 360.01, result-day low Rs 363.65.
Global chemical peers tracked averaged -2.5% in their last session. Last filing is the 28 Oct result; no bulk or block deal in 10 days.
SEBI matter adjourned to 5 Jan 2027 for final disposal; the 2023 order remains stayed.

BHAGERIA.watch: The exit signal stays open in My trades; only a close above Rs 360.01 clears it.
